invariants: AI never chooses the next permanent ID
one intent may atomically contain multiple logical operations
every applied intent produces an immutable transaction record
hypothesis and experiment references must resolve
historical research is never silently rewritten

scaling_policy.operational_json: metadata and current scientific state only
scaling_policy.large_raw_series: never store millions of ticks in dashboard JSON; use dedicated object/time-series storage and keep manifests/hashes in GitHub
scaling_policy.archive_strategy: shard cold immutable records by year/month when operational projections become large
scaling_policy.site_strategy: render from generated projections; add lazy archive loading when archival threshold is reached
scaling_policy.migration_rule: schema changes are versioned and prospective; old evidence remains addressable
